page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-highmem-30-lssd is a memory-optimized server instance powered by an AMD EPYC 9B14 processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture. It features 30 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 15 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The system is equipped with 240 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8 GB per vCPU. Storage is bundled directly with the instance, consisting of two local NVMe SSDs totaling 804 GB of high-speed local capacity.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong single-core CPU capabilities, with stress-ng single-core performance placing in the top 25%. Multi-core CPU performance and PassMark CPU scores sit in the middle tier. Memory performance is highlighted by a strong PassMark memory score, although large-block memory write bandwidth is relatively weak, falling into the bottom 25%. Cryptographic and vector processing are accelerated via hardware flags including AVX-512 and AES. Large-block read bandwidth remains average, as does static web serving throughput and database operations.

The instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound workloads due to its high RAM density paired with local NVMe storage, reducing the need to provision larger, more expensive compute nodes solely for memory capacity. The local SSDs provide low-latency storage access, making this server well-suited for database operations, in-memory caching, software compilation, and medium-scale language model inference.
